scope: Scalar finalized-mean/variance to invstd/alpha/offset engine for M232 H67 current-batch BN coefficient streaming

innovation.name: barrier-slack-harvested scalar coefficient engine
innovation.mechanism: A segmented 64-entry rsqrt LUT, one Newton step and gamma/beta affine finalization reuse one scalar multiplier because M232 proves coefficient service can be hidden under channel-major replay at output interval up to 31 cycles.
innovation.wide_pool_reuse: The scalar engine does not duplicate M167's shared96 projection pool; M167 PREFOLD remains separately scheduled for alpha-times-left temporal coefficients.

fail_closed_exclusions: channel-major state SRAM and BN2 affine/residual ports
ATLIF event equivalence, valid825, full BN/FFN/system speedup
SRAM macro, PTPX energy and paper-ready PPA
